intentEvidence: Share files between vaults using WebRTC peer-to-peer connections
problem: Users need a secure, private way to transfer files and folders between different Obsidian vaults without relying on cloud storage or external services.

relations.evidence: Built on the protocol and public server of PairDrop, for Obsidian.

summary: Peer Share allows users to send files and folders between different Obsidian vaults directly from device to device using WebRTC peer-to-peer connections.
